name: google-analytics
description: Google Analytics: adds the Google tag for your GA4 measurement ID to every public page, with a way to leave your own visits out.

measurement_id.title: Measurement ID
measurement_id.description: From analytics.google.com > Admin > Data streams, e.g. G-ABC123XYZ9. A Google tag ID (GT-...) also works. Leave empty to turn the tag off.
